scope: automatic building income and local Production Methods research

ownerPolicy.hud: own Dream faction or own positive S; non-Dream positive S is read-only
ownerPolicy.refunds: Receipt-backed production and research refunds return to the original payer in the same account epoch, without faction gating; building construction cancellation instead uses the paid cost snapshot and native current-owner refund semantics.

dependencies: core stage-B2 EconomyBalanceSync authoritative owner-only FWO+extra snapshot

productionMethods.scope: one physical garden, mine, or furnace
productionMethods.pendingOnRestart: refund actual receipt to original account epoch
productionMethods.clockMigration: Schema 1: preserve elapsed old ticks as twice that many integer work units, with a fresh 200-active-tick settlement window. Schema 2 also persists the current window. No offline accrual.
productionMethods.rounding: Carry the work remainder between successful batches. Drop unreceivable excess at cap. Credit, score and balance sync use actual credited integers.
